pair_policy: All combinations across each consecutive pair of reviewed timestamps, plus all combinations between first and last timestamps. Same-frame pairs excluded. Report same-team false merges separately. Frames and pairs are highly dependent.
limitations: Sparse assistant identity references for two clips, not exhaustive player labels, independent human ground truth, HOTA, IDF1, or whole-game accuracy. The underlying recording was seen for sparse detection tests. The new contiguous intervals and tracker predictions were not viewed before this protocol and labeling. All five trackers and both frozen detectors are reported. Missing endpoints are not correct rejections. These results do not select a new model or tune thresholds. Appearance rules specific to the previous red/white teams were not applied to these blue/black uniforms.
